2.
The application stands disposed of.
CM APPL. 46135/2024 (Condonation of delay).
3. This is an application under Section 5 of Limitation Act, 1963 read with Section 151 of the Code of Civil Procedure, 1908 for condonation of delay in filing the instant appeal.
4. For the reason stated in the application, the delay of 16 days in filing the instant appeal is condoned.
5. The application is disposed of.

sentences.text: 7. Learned counsel appearing on behalf of appellant submitted that in the present matter, notice may be issued to the respondent no.1 and the notice qua the respondent no. 2 may be dispensed with.

8. Heard.
9.
Issue notice of the appeal and the accompanying application to respondent no. 1 through all permissible modes on filing PF within one week.
10. This Court is of the considered view that the matter requires consideration.

Subject to the appellant's depositing the entire compensation amount along with the interest from the date of the institution of the claim as per the impugned award before the Registrar General of this Court within a period of four weeks, the operation of the impugned award dated 20 th April, 2024 shall remain stayed till the next date of hearing.
The amount so deposited by the appellant shall be invested in an interest bearing FDR in an auto renewal mode.
11. List on 18th September, 2024 before Joint Registrar (Judicial) for completion of service and pleadings.
CHANDRA DHARI SINGH, J AUGUST 12, 2024 rk/aa
